hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: Alpha hypothesis: using a four-role Investment Team before machine qualification may produce better candidate ideas. The blocker tested here is operational: one operator currently has to invoke many lifecycle commands. A three-command facade can reduce manual error while delegating every existing guard unchanged.

in_flight_duplicate_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §7 并发重复 reserve: the novelty gate cannot see in-flight tickets, so reservation re-checks open proposed/claimed/running tickets from the last 7 days and blocks fingerprint near-duplicates (score >= 0.65). Coordinate via scripts/list_experiments.py and scripts/agent_mailbox.py instead of racing.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

recipe_lane_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 排名/枚举清单消费: consuming a ranked list or finite taxonomy with one fixed evaluation recipe, one item per ID, is loop unrolling — not new evidence. After the lane triggers, only a single pooled batch (once) or park is legal. Curated lanes: docs/recipe_lanes.jsonl.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

routine_materialization_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 routine delta materialization: after 3 routine forward-ledger materialization IDs (one concrete surface, or same-shape across surfaces within 7 days), wire the materialization into run.py / the settlement pipeline once instead of reserving further manual IDs. Fault recovery is exempt.

saturated_source_axis.rule: For saturated (gate_shape, data_source) cells, legal override axes are limited to a new data source, a new gate shape, or materially more closed/settled forward rows. Same-source new fields/tags do not qualify.

prediction.confidence_reason: The facade delegates existing guarded entry points and removes only redundant operator invocations, so the main risk is orchestration state handling rather than strategy logic.

calibration.surprise_note: Concurrency review exposed legacy terminal-overwrite and accepted-override gaps, so the final repair includes narrow registry guards in addition to the three-command facade.
